'''Erica Carlyle''' is an [[ally]]. She first appears in the [[Curse of the Dark Pharaoh]] expansion, and was updated in the [[The_Curse_of_the_Dark_Pharaoh_(Revised_Edition)|revised edition]]. Erica can be gained through an [[encounter]] at [[Hibb's Roadhouse]] or, when combining [[Miskatonic Horror]] with [[Innsmouth Horror]], at the [[Devil Reef]].

==Card info==
*+2 [[Spell]]

Gain a [[Retainer]] card when Erica Carlyle joins you.
